decisions.reason: Although slack could carry it temporarily, its peripheral consumer positioning and likely below-aspiration performance in a crowded German organic market make redeployment to core technologies probable.
As a modular extension of the established waste-to-energy line, it fits core capabilities and existing customers, so management will likely keep it unless results fall clearly short of aspirations.
Its flagship status and central role in the firm's waste-to-energy direction mean management will tolerate shortfalls and use slack to keep it on the market.
Its flagship status and closeness to the established offer give it strong strategic commitment, so management is unlikely to drop it near-term.
